response.original_title: Dissidence. Deux ombres sur le mur
response.overview: Ravianto and Raviandi Ramadhan are two newcomers to the World Climbing Championships scene. Driven only by passion and lofty aspirations, two Indonesian twin brothers set out into the world without sponsors. The documentary "Dissidence" chronicles their incredible trip from the fabled crags of France to the climbing walls of their native country. It is a heartfelt homage to their bravery, fraternity, and tenacity. Ravianto and Raviandi fight to have their views heard internationally while challenging the current quo.
response.title: Dissidence - Two Shadows on the Wall
